In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''petitioner''' worked in the streets of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]], requesting aid for the [[Mek-Sha Home for Lost Children]]. A representative of the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] granted the Kel Dor a donation to help the Home for Lost Children.<ref name="Dash" />
